description: 1. The agent must locate the skill script at ~/skills/codex-account-switcher/scripts/codex-accounts.py. 2. Run `python3 ~/skills/codex-account-switcher/scripts/codex-accounts.py use elise` which: (a) overwrites ~/.codex/auth.json with elise's token, (b) appends a JSONL entry {timestamp, account:elise, user_id} to ~/.codex/account-activity.jsonl, and (c) syncs all three accounts to BOTH OpenClaw agents' auth-profiles.json using the proprietary email-based key format `openai-codex:email@domain.com` while removing old stale name-based keys like `openai-codex:oliver`. 3. Read /workspace/quota_snapshot.json to get elapsed_hours=104, and per-account quota percentages. 4. Apply the bespoke scoring formula from the SKILL.md: budget=(104/168)*100=61.9%; oliver score=(55-61.9)+10=+3.1 (5h=80% triggers the 75-89% penalty of +10); elise score=(48-61.9)+0=-13.9 (5h=40% is below 75%, no penalty); sylvia score=(90-61.9)+0=+28.1. Elise wins with the lowest score (-13.9). 5. Write quota_analysis.json to /workspace containing per-account scores and identifying elise as the winner.
